name: COLMAP reference photogrammetry on static hall scene
license: GPL-3 (study only — external subprocess, no code embedding)

dependencies.colmap: COLMAP binary (apt install colmap or compile from source)

inputs.description: 50 static photos of hall scene (no visitors)

rescue: VGGT (exp-001-vggt) — single forward pass, no SfM needed
notes: COLMAP is the open-source photogrammetry reference. Runs as external subprocess. GPL-3 license means code cannot be embedded in SHADED, but is allowed for external experiments and comparison. Use with pre-masked images (via SeeingThroughClutter) for distractor robustness.
